posts.post_text: Adjust announced a Superwall integration that sends subscription lifecycle events from iOS, Android, and Stripe into Adjust for cleaner measurement and optimization.
Fraudlogix shared a new breakdown of invalid traffic patterns across mobile acquisition, with practical guidance on cleaner traffic and verification checkpoints.
Jason Fairchild argued that app marketers are starting to expect CTV inventory to behave like measurable performance media instead of pure awareness spend.
Gadi Eliashiv posted that incrementality measurement is becoming a board-level budgeting question, not just an analyst workflow, as app teams push for cleaner ROI proof.
Mobile Dev Memo highlighted how Privacy Sandbox changes are reshaping mobile growth planning, especially for attribution windows, signal loss, and budget calibration.
